function.name: ADVANCE
function.abstract: It moves the current process according to his angle

description.p: This function moves the current process in the direction specified for his variable the number of units indicated like parameter.

We must consider that the movement is in entire units, and so it has limitations of precision. A movement of 1 or 2 units can not reflect the differences among angles, so it will not efective. If we want to move a process in arbitrary angles and only a few pixels, it will be necessary to use the variable so that the coordinates of the graph come expressed in smaller units than a pixel, how it happens default.
